# Yao Guai Spawns: All locations including map

Yao Guai and cooked dishes made from Yao Guai meat are often part of daily and weekly challenges. For example, Yao Guai ribs, which must be sold to an NPC dealer.

But dishes with Yao Guai meat are also a very interesting buff for melee fighters thanks to the carnivore mutation. “Delicious Yao Guai Roast” can be stored well in the freezer. With the locations from this article you can farm the meat and store the dishes for later.

## Yao Guai spawn locations

- Swamp
 - 2x Dolly Sods Wilderness
- Savage Divide
 - 2x Bed & Breakfast on the mountain
